facts.text: Gina mentioned she has been working hard on her online store and recently teamed up with a local artist for some cool designs.

evidence.quote: I've been working hard on my online store and just teamed up with a local artist for some cool designs.

facts.text: Gina explained that the idea for the cool designs came from a fashion magazine and that she saw a gap in the market for similar items.

evidence.quote: I got the idea from a fashion mag and saw there wasn't much around like it.

facts.text: Gina and the local artist collaborated to create the designs, with the goal of offering something different to her customers.

evidence.quote: So I worked with the artist to make it happen - it's all about being ahead of the game and giving my customers something different.

facts.text: Jon acknowledged Gina's commitment and creativity in her business and asked how she came up with the cool designs.

evidence.quote: It looks awesome. Your commitment and creativity in your business really stands out. How'd you come up with these cool designs?
